Migrate workflows from other CI platforms to CircleCI

## Usage

`circleci migrate <command> [flags]`

## General Commands

| Command   | Description                                              |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `actions` | Copy a GitHub Actions workflow into .circleci/workflows/ |

## Flags

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Details

Commands for migrating CI workflows from other platforms into CircleCI.

Use these commands to copy workflow files into a layout that CircleCI
can run directly.
